name: Dead Air
detailed_description:
Step into the shoes of Luna Hart, a late-night radio host who's only here filling in for the weekend. In dead air you have to choose who gets to live, and who gets to die. With your friend Cody by your side, you are this towns last line of defense against what goes bump in the night. 

What You Say Matters

As eerie calls flood in, guide listeners through cryptid encounters by asking the right questions, solving mysteries, and making snap decisions. Every call is its own unique story, with over 21 unique calls to experience.

  • Choice-Driven Horror: Navigate branching conversations in real time, where every answer could save—or doom—a caller.

  • Investigate the Unknown: Piece together cryptid clues from whispered rumors, strange evidence, and frantic voices.

  • Face Legendary Creatures: Encounter nightmarish versions of cryptids like the Moth man, Chupacabra, and Wendigo—each with unique behaviors and chilling lore.

Features

  •  A unique mix of radio host simulation and psychological horror

  • Multi-phase boss encounters that blend puzzles, exploration, and survival

  • Collect cryptid files with cryptic clues to help you survive future calls

  • Dynamic station events, including power outages, flooded rooms, and uninvited guests

  • Fully voiced characters with branching dialogue.

short_description: A horror themed choose your adventure, dead air follows Luna Hart as she has to answer radio calls. Vote on cryptids, save or end lives, and try to make it to dawn as best you can. Are you up for the challenge?
